metadata.trace_title: Draft a weekly status email from bullet points

messages.content:
You extract the reusable, parameterized intent from a noisy execution trace.
Strip out errors, retries, and one-off details. Focus on what a practitioner
would need to reproduce the outcome on different inputs.
Respond only with the JSON schema requested — no commentary.
Trace title: Draft a weekly status email from bullet points

response.goal: Draft a formal weekly status email from provided bullet points.

input_variables.name: bullet_points
input_variables.description: List of accomplishments and updates for the week.
input_variables.example: finished auth module, fixed 3 bugs in payment flow

input_variables.name: manager_name
input_variables.description: Name of the manager to address.

input_variables.name: week_date
input_variables.description: The week date for the status update.

input_variables.name: sender_name
input_variables.description: Name of the person sending the email.

key_steps.action: Receive bullet points from the user
key_steps.why: These form the core content of the email.

key_steps.action: Draft a formal email with an accomplishments section and a blockers section
Sign the email with the sender's name

response.output_description: A formal weekly status update email addressed to the manager.
constraints: Email must be formal in tone
Must include a Blockers section even if empty
